item.title: Mamdani says Trump to grant visa to mother of boy killed in Bronx shooting

item.title: UN demands investigation after staffer’s death in Houthi custody in Yemen

item.title: France protests enter third week as police fire tear gas

item.title: FBI blames North Korea for record $6.3bn crypto heist from Binance

item.title: Thousands rally in Israel urging ‘Jewish-Arab’ coalition to oust Netanyahu
item.description: In a counterprotest, Netanyahu supporters demand that Israel should not have a government with 'terrorists'.

item.title: Talarico draws a packed campus rally, but can he win over young voters?

item.title: Polish president holds crisis talks in court standoff
item.description: A dispute over the politicisation of Poland's constitutional court is deepening, with no side appearing to back down.
